sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Repair the accidental applicability pass logic: the third sh:or SPARQL constraint currently selects non-CP ships, so it passes for CP ships and can bypass the CP formula branch. Make that alternative pass only when propellerType is non-CP, for example by selecting CP ships so the constraint is violated for CP, while retaining the CP true/false branches, operand/result paths, metre unit checks, and the max(relative tolerance scaled from the expected 0.7*free-running value, absolute 1e-6) comparison. Also remove the unverified canonical vocabulary IRI nltl:TRF084Shape and use a blank-node shape or another non-vocabulary shape identifier; no vocabulary matcher is needed.
